title: Kokand
long_description: Kokand, known as the City of Winds, was once the capital of the powerful Kokand Khanate. Today it offers beautiful palaces, mosques and a glimpse into the regions rich history.

faqs.question: How do I get to Kokand?
faqs.answer: Kokand is accessible by train or shared taxi from Tashkent through the Fergana Valley.
